title: USAID former headquarters at Ronald Reagan Building
summary: A current USAID OIG page identifies USAID OIG Headquarters at the Ronald Reagan Building, 1300 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, D.C. 20523. Because USAID's independent operating structure was dismantled and functions transferred to State, this packet preserves the address as USAID's former agency headquarters rather than asserting a current independent-agency headquarters.

data.research_question: What defensible public location history can be added for USAID, and what material current evidence updates the dataset after the HQ slice?
data.method: Refreshed current main, recent successful hourly merges, open work, operating documentation, executable v0.9.0 schema, topic manifest, and the complete global dataset/topic universe through the GitHub connector. Sorted the 54-entry universe lexicographically and removed the previous-three successful datasets. The first deterministic draw landed on occrp-aleph; its sole recorded investigation target is blocked by lack of visible collections and its manifest contains no imported organization IDs, so it was recorded as non-actionable for the required HQ phase. Re-indexing the remaining pool with the same seed selected usaid-doge-mortality-accountability. Existing organization candidates in that packet were sorted and selected using the target-stage seed, yielding o:usaid. Reviewed public government evidence for USAID's Washington headquarters history, preserving former-headquarters semantics because independent USAID functions were transferred. Only after the location slice was bounded, searched current official oversight and news surfaces and ingested the July 2026 State OIG evaluation as a material oversight event.
classification_rules: Dataset-stage sampling is independent of row count.
Previous-three successful hourly datasets are hard exclusions when alternatives exist.
A dataset unable to supply an actionable unblocked HQ-phase target is rejected explicitly and recorded.
Previous-three dominant geographies London/United Kingdom, China/Beijing-Hainan, and New York/United States are avoided when alternatives exist.
Former headquarters, current headquarters, office, oversight office, and successor-agency location remain distinct.
No coordinates are created without geocoder-backed or first-party coordinate evidence.
Current news is ingested only when it materially updates an event, claim, relation, or organizational state.

findings.selection_algorithm: sort complete dataset/topic pool lexicographically; remove previous-three hard exclusions; choose eligible_pool[seed mod len]; reject only a selected dataset that has no actionable unblocked HQ-phase target and record that exclusion; re-index with the same seed; sort target pool and choose target_pool[target_seed mod len]

findings.result: Public government evidence identifies 1300 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20523 as USAID's Washington headquarters address; a current USAID OIG page still labels the Ronald Reagan Building as USAID OIG Headquarters. This pass records former agency headquarters semantics and does not infer a current USAID-wide headquarters.

State OIG's July 2026 AUD-FA-26-17 found 17 State bureaus/offices administering 1,504 transferred USAID programs and associated awards with $51.5 billion obligated, while identifying staffing, training, IT/data, and guidance challenges; prior May 2025 recommendations were not fully implemented as of July 2026.
